description.yash.advanced_locked: Switch to Advanced mode to edit fine-grained animation values.
description.yash.effect.arrival_pulse: Briefly enlarges the selector when it reaches the selected slot.
description.yash.effect.glow: Adds a soft colored glow behind the selector.
description.yash.effect.opacity: Adjusts selector visibility without making it fully invisible.
description.yash.effect.scale: Changes selector size while keeping it centered on the selected slot.
description.yash.effect.stretch: Stretches the selector horizontally according to movement speed.
description.yash.effect.tint: Blends a custom color with the selector's original artwork.
description.yash.hex_color: Enter a color in #RRGGBB format. Invalid values are not applied.
description.yash.mode: Basic mode shows everyday controls; Advanced mode exposes fine tuning.
description.yash.preset: Apply all values from the %s preset.
description.yash.reset_defaults: Restore every YASH option to its safe default value.
description.yash.theme.bee: A bright yellow-and-black frame with compact wing accents.
description.yash.theme.clean: A thin white and light-gray frame for a minimal look.
description.yash.theme.creeper: A green pixel frame with subtle Creeper-inspired corner details.
description.yash.theme.enderman: A dark purple frame with bright eye accents.
description.yash.theme.vanilla_resource_: Uses the hotbar selector supplied by the currently active resource pack.
description.yash.theme.wolf: A gray-white frame with small ears and a red collar accent.
